description: The organism a recording came from. Distinct from pub.layers.persona.persona, an interpretive framework deliberately shared across many humans, and from pub.layers.defs#agentRef, which is inline and therefore neither addressable by AT-URI nor individually deletable.

main.description: A research participant, subject, speaker, signer, or consultant. A separate record rather than a hierarchy level for three reasons: the same person recurs across studies, so a node with one parent cannot hold them; withdrawal must delete one record rather than collapse a level; and consent-bearing data about a third party must never be embedded in records that cannot be individually erased. DE-IDENTIFICATION IS BY CONSTRUCTION: this record carries no name, no e-mail, no DID, no date of birth and no free-text identifier field, because Layers records live in public PDSes and are broadcast on the firehose, so anything written here must be safe to publish at the moment it is written. A publisher who cannot satisfy that MUST reference a gated external repository through media.externalUri with access.mode set accordingly.

participantId.description: Pseudonymous identifier, stable within the authoring repo and meaningless outside it (sub-01, P17). BIDS participant_id, REQUIRED and the first column of participants.tsv. MUST NOT be a name, an e-mail address, a DID, a handle, an institutional identifier, a worker-platform identifier that resolves to an account, or any string derived from a birth date.

speciesUri.description: AT-URI of the species definition node. Grounded through knowledgeRefs with source ncbi-taxonomy rather than a Layers-local vocabulary.

species.description: Species slug (fallback when speciesUri unavailable). BIDS participants.tsv species, which expects an NCBI Taxonomy binomial; NWB Subject.species. Ground the binomial through knowledgeRefs with source ncbi-taxonomy rather than minting Layers-local nodes.

strainRef.description: Strain for non-human subjects, grounded via rrid. BIDS strain_rrid; NWB Subject.strain. No free-text twin: two encodings of one fact with no precedence rule is a conflict waiting to be written.

genotype.description: Genotype for non-human subjects. NWB Subject.genotype.

ageMonths.description: Age at first participation in whole months, so infant, child-language and animal work is expressible without floats; NWB Subject.age uses an ISO 8601 duration for the same reason. BIDS caps participants.tsv age at 89 years for privacy, so values above 1068 SHOULD be clamped with ageIsCapped set. In small or clinical populations age alone is a quasi-identifier and may legitimately be omitted.

ageIsCapped.description: True when ageMonths is clamped and the true value is greater. Distinguishes a clamped 89-year-old from a real one.

ageReferenceUri.description: AT-URI of the age reference definition node.

ageReference.description: What ageMonths is measured from (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). NWB Subject.age__reference, which takes birth or gestational. Load-bearing for infant work, where the two differ by months.

sexUri.description: AT-URI of the sex definition node.

sex.description: Biological sex as recorded by the study (fallback when sexUri unavailable). BIDS participants.tsv sex; NWB Subject.sex. Deliberately distinct from gender, because collapsing them is both scientifically and ethically wrong.

genderUri.description: AT-URI of the gender definition node.

gender.description: Self-reported gender slug (fallback when genderUri unavailable). No BIDS or NWB counterpart; added because sociolinguistic and psycholinguistic work routinely collects it and would otherwise put it in an untyped feature.

handednessUri.description: AT-URI of the handedness definition node.

handedness.description: Handedness slug (fallback when handednessUri unavailable). BIDS participants.tsv handedness, a near-universal inclusion criterion in neurolinguistic work.

handednessScore.description: Laterality quotient scaled to per mille, so an Edinburgh Handedness Inventory score of -100.0 to +100.0 becomes -1000 to 1000.

hearingStatusUri.description: AT-URI of the hearing status definition node.

hearingStatus.description: Hearing status slug (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). No BIDS or NWB counterpart; load-bearing for sign language and speech perception research, where it is a defining participant variable.

visionStatusUri.description: AT-URI of the vision status definition node.

visionStatus.description: Vision status slug (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). Relevant to eye-tracking and reading studies, where corrected-to-normal is a routine inclusion criterion and correction type affects tracker performance.

weightGrams.description: Body weight in grams. NWB Subject.weight, kilograms upstream. Primarily an animal-work field; for humans it is a quasi-identifier in small samples and is usually better omitted.

languageProfiles.description: Per-language background, each a pub.layers.acquisition.defs#languageCompetence. A bare BCP-47 array cannot distinguish an L1 Finnish speaker with late L2 English from a simultaneous bilingual, and that distinction is the point of most of the research this record serves.

languages.description: Canonical BCP-47 tags this participant produced or comprehended data in, including sign language tags. A flat facet for filtering; languageProfiles carries the structure. No array-level cap, since a multilingual consultant's repertoire has no natural bound; the record size limit governs.

languageRefs.description: Structured language references complementing languages, each a pub.layers.defs#languageRef. Carries a variety below the language level and grounding of a languoid whose identity is contested, which a bare BCP-47 tag cannot. No array-level cap; the record size limit governs.

consent.description: REQUIRED. The basis on which this participant's data may be published and redistributed. Required rather than optional because a participant record with no consent declaration is a claim about a person with no stated warrant, and no consumer can tell an unrecorded consent from an absent one.

access.description: Conditions under which this participant's data may be obtained, when narrower than the collection's.

knowledgeRefs.description: External grounding: ncbi-taxonomy for species, rrid for strain. MUST NOT carry an ORCID or any identifier resolving to a named human, which is what distinguishes this field from every other knowledgeRefs field in the lexicon.

metadata.description: Provenance: who created this participant record, with what tool.

features.description: Study-specific variables (education, clinical group, screening scores). Keys SHOULD be declared as a column schema on the containing collection. MUST NOT reintroduce a direct identifier the typed fields deliberately omit.

createdAt.description: When this participant record was created.
